## Rowen Seykora {style="font-size: 1em; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0px;"}

# (she/her, "sih-kora") {style="font-size: 1em; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 5px;"}
:::

::: {style="max-width: 500px; margin: 5px auto; text-align: justify; border: 0px solid #ccc; padding: 2px; border-radius: 5px; background-color: transparent;"}
Life sciences professional with a background in host-pathogen interactions and systems immunology, complemented by experience with viral and bacterial infection models, quantitative assays, and biomedical informatics. My interests center on how microbial and host factors shape infection and disease, and how these interactions manifest across scales, from molecular mechanisms and microbial communities to population-level patterns. I aim to build on my experience in microbiology and human health through graduate research that combines mechanistic investigation with data-driven approaches to infectious disease.
:::
